title: Chelsea Are Buying AND Selling More Than Anyone

scenes.voiceover: Chelsea are the biggest spenders in Europe this summer, and one of the biggest sellers too.
scenes.visualConcept: host cold open, immediate paradox claim

scenes.voiceover: Three hundred and forty seven million pounds on thirteen new signings, including a club record hundred and seventeen million for Morgan Rogers.
scenes.kicker: INCL. A CLUB-RECORD £117M FOR MORGAN ROGERS
scenes.visualConcept: the spend number lands hard, instantly

scenes.voiceover: At the same time, they've sold at least eight players this summer for a combined two hundred and forty one million.
scenes.kicker: AND DEADLINE DAY ISN'T HERE YET
scenes.visualConcept: the sell number, same weight as the spend number

scenes.voiceover: Cucurella to Real Madrid. Andrey Santos to Man United. Nicolas Jackson to Aston Villa for up to sixty five million.
scenes.visualConcept: names stack up fast, one per beat

scenes.voiceover: This isn't new. In 2023, Chelsea sold two hundred and twenty six million pounds worth of players too.
scenes.kicker: THIS IS THEIR 2ND BIG SELL-OFF IN 3 YEARS
scenes.visualConcept: bar chart, 2023 vs 2026 sales, near-identical height

scenes.voiceover: Buy huge. Sell huge. Repeat. It's one of the most extreme buy and sell operations in world football.
scenes.visualConcept: the two bars from before slam together into one identity

scenes.voiceover: And a reported hundred and forty million euro move for Enzo Fernandez to Man City still isn't done.
scenes.mainText: ENZO TO CITY: NOT DONE YET
scenes.visualConcept: open loop — a deal still hanging

scenes.voiceover: If that closes, this could be Chelsea's biggest-selling summer yet. Follow for the update.
